desc: Combining the style of old world manufacturing and the efficiency of modern CNC machines Tokarev USA aims to bring quality firearms to the market. The BullPump is one such firearm, this 12 Gauge pump action shotgun is made with all the skill and craftsmanship as the original Tula plant. The shotgun is a an easy to use compact solution for a defensive shot gun with its bullpup configuration. The Tokarev BullPump uses a 18.5" barrel that sits inside of the assembly making for a compact profile. The shotgun uses a similar safety to an AR for a comfortable operation. The shotgun uses detachable magazines that can help with a more rapid reloads.
